title: Kiểm tra tuần 11: Speaking và tối ưu band
passage:
Intelligibility over Accent

For many years, language learners were encouraged to imitate the accent of a native speaker as closely as possible. Recordings of British or American voices were treated as the model, and any difference from that model was considered an error. In recent decades, however, many linguists have questioned this approach.

The central argument is that the goal of speaking a second language is to be understood, not to sound like someone from London or New York. Research on conversations between non-native speakers, for example, has identified the pronunciation features that most strongly affect whether international listeners can follow a speaker. These include the clear pronunciation of most consonant sounds, the difference between long and short vowels, and the placement of stress on the most important word in a phrase. By contrast, some features that teachers often spend hours on, such as the 'th' sounds in 'think' and 'this', caused relatively few misunderstandings.

This shift has practical consequences for learners. Rather than trying to remove every trace of their first language, students can concentrate on the features that matter most. Learners from Vietnam, for instance, often omit final consonants, so that 'rice', 'right' and 'ride' may sound identical. Correcting this single habit may improve intelligibility more than months of work on intonation patterns.

Not everyone accepts this view. Some teachers argue that learners themselves often want to sound native-like and that lowering the target may limit their progress. Nevertheless, major international speaking tests now assess pronunciation according to how easily a candidate can be understood, rather than how closely they resemble any particular accent.

questions.q: Speaking Part 1. Examiner: "Do you like cooking?" Which answer is the most suitable?
options: Yes, I do, actually. I usually cook dinner at weekends because it helps me relax after a busy week.
Cooking is defined as the preparation of food using heat, and it has a long history in human civilisation, which I will now explain in detail.
questions.explain: Part 1 nên trả lời tự nhiên, trực tiếp rồi thêm lý do hoặc ví dụ ngắn. Trả lời một từ hoặc như đọc bài học thuộc đều bị đánh giá thấp.

questions.q: How long should a typical answer in Speaking Part 1 be?
questions.explain: Part 1 có nhiều câu hỏi ngắn, mỗi câu trả lời khoảng 2–3 câu là phù hợp. Nói 2 phút là dành cho Part 2.

questions.q: In Speaking Part 2 you have one minute to prepare. What is the most effective use of this time?
options: Write out your whole answer in full sentences
Note down key words for each prompt on the cue card
Ask the examiner for a different topic
questions.explain: Một phút không đủ viết cả bài; ghi từ khóa cho từng gợi ý giúp bạn nói đủ ý và mạch lạc trong 2 phút.

questions.q: Speaking Part 2 cue card: "Describe a trip you remember well." Which answer structure is the most effective?
options: Set the scene (when, where, who) → describe what happened in order → explain why it was memorable
Say why it was memorable in one sentence, then stop after 30 seconds
Mention a different trip in every sentence
Give a list of adjectives about travelling in general
questions.explain: Kể chuyện theo trình tự bối cảnh → diễn biến → cảm nhận giúp bài nói mạch lạc và đủ thời lượng 2 phút.

questions.q: Speaking Part 3. Examiner: "Do you think people travel more now than in the past?" Which answer develops an argument with a reason and a comparison?
options: I went to Da Nang last year.
Travel is travel, so I am not sure.
Definitely, mainly because flights have become much cheaper. Budget airlines now offer low-cost tickets, whereas twenty years ago flying was a luxury for most families.
questions.explain: Part 3 cần trả lời rõ, giải thích lý do và so sánh (whereas...). Kể trải nghiệm cá nhân đơn thuần chưa đủ để lập luận.

questions.q: Pronunciation: which word is stressed on the SECOND syllable?
questions.explain: pho-TO-gra-phy nhấn âm 2; PHO-to-graph và TE-le-phone nhấn âm 1; pho-to-GRA-phic nhấn âm 3.

questions.q: Lexical Resource: you have already said "very good" twice about a meal. Which word is a more precise alternative?
questions.explain: "Delicious" chính xác và tự nhiên khi khen món ăn, giúp tăng điểm từ vựng. Các phương án còn lại sai hoặc lặp từ.

questions.q: Grammatical Range: which sentence contains a complex structure (a subordinate clause)?
options: I like music and I play the guitar.
Although I'm usually busy, I always make time to play the guitar.
questions.explain: Câu dùng "Although" có mệnh đề phụ, là câu phức. Câu B chỉ là câu ghép nối bằng "and".

questions.q: Choose the natural collocation: "I've been ______ busy at work lately."
questions.explain: "Incredibly busy" là cách nói tự nhiên. Không dùng "strongly/heavily/deeply busy".

questions.q: "I only eat fast food once in a blue moon." What does "once in a blue moon" mean?
questions.explain: "Once in a blue moon" nghĩa là hiếm khi, rất ít khi.

questions.q: Choose the correct collocation: "I have ______ a lot of progress with my English this year."
"A new phone costs an arm and a leg these days." What does "cost an arm and a leg" mean?
questions.explain: "Cost an arm and a leg" là thành ngữ nghĩa là rất đắt.

questions.q: True, False or Not Given? "According to the passage, all teachers now agree that learners do not need native-like pronunciation."
questions.explain: Đoạn cuối nói "Not everyone accepts this view" và một số giáo viên phản đối, nên câu này sai: False.

questions.q: Which heading best fits the third paragraph (beginning "This shift has practical consequences")?
options: Practical advice: focus on the features that matter most
questions.explain: Đoạn 3 khuyên người học tập trung vào những đặc điểm phát âm quan trọng nhất, ví dụ âm cuối.

questions.q: Why does the writer mention the words 'rice', 'right' and 'ride'?
options: To show how dropping final consonants can make different words sound the same
To show why the 'th' sound is difficult
To give an example of intonation patterns
To illustrate the difference between long and short vowels
questions.explain: Ba từ này chỉ khác nhau ở âm cuối; nếu bỏ âm cuối, chúng nghe giống hệt nhau.
